Robert Louis Stevenson, Kidnapped.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/robert-louis-stevenson/kidnapped

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Robert Louis Stevenson, the annotator, died 1894 (Wikidata death date).

First publication of the text used: 1886 (SE colophon: 'Kidnapped was published in 1886 by Robert Louis Stevenson').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the edition's rights statement (quoted below) says the text is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin (the facts do not establish the country of first publication, and the text was first published 1886): public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The last person to die, Robert Louis Stevenson, died in 1894, so that term ended on 31 December 1994 at the latest.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: Kidnapped was published in 1886 by Robert Louis Stevenson.
- Wikidata Q1512 (Robert Louis Stevenson), P570 = 1894-12-03
